movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Devils hold tridents; angels hold swords.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Group formations, often in streets or plazas.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes jumps to represent the battle.
movement_profile.partnering: Confrontational interaction between angels and devils.
movement_profile.posture: Upright and aggressive for devils; graceful for angels.

signature_moves.description: A rhythmic, high-kneed march used to clear the path.
signature_moves.name: Devil's march

music_profile.sound_description: A driving, syncopated rhythm led by panpipes (sikus) and supported by a percussion section of bass drums, snare drums, and triangles.

basic_steps: Marching with high knees to represent the devil's presence.
Jumping movements to signify the battle between angels and demons.
Coordinated group movement following the Caporal.
teaching.formation: Processional and group formations in squares or streets.
teaching.level_notes: Intermediate: requires stamina and coordination for the jumps and character-specific movements.
